title: New to game dev. Is this sprite quality actually good enough for a real game?
author: Round-Telephone-9807
selftext:
I’m completely new to game development and have been trying a bunch of AI tools.  
One thing I noticed is that generating characters directly with AI usually looks nice as concept art, but it’s surprisingly hard to get something that actually works in a game.  
I recently found a prompt-to-spritesheet tool. What surprised me was that using a reference image seems to keep the character much more consistent across different animations. it is called Gorest.

I’m curious what more experienced game developers think.  
Would sprites like these actually be usable in an indie game?  
Or are they still missing important things that you’d normally expect before putting them into a project?  
I’d really appreciate honest feedback, especially from people who’ve shipped games.
